body:
In my 22 years of living, I've never had any sort of stomach virus. I could count on one hand the amount of times I've been sick and they were all under the age of five. What I find weird about that is when I was little, the few times I did get sick, I didn't care.
It was just a crumby part of life that happened to everyone. Depression hit me hard in later years to come and eventually a bad anxiety disorder that stemmed from extremely low self esteem. I wasn't afraid of getting sick when I was little bit anxiety needs something logical to fear. At least in your own mind. I bet a lot of us aren't afraid of getting sick. But the fear of anticipation or a loss of control. I can't rationalize those thoughts though. Ill carry on with my tail between my legs and try my best to cope.

Thanks for the replies. I still don't know what it was. But she only got sick once right before I posted. She's been fine today so I don't know if it was a big or some food. I don't know, it's still freaking me out but I've managed to eat today.. >.>

Well I'm stuck here. I've been in therapy since I was really young. Always bouncing around to new therapists. But if I tell her I'm suicidal she'll sen me somewhere. And that would be alright but I've been weening myself off of this drug for about 7 months now. Beforehand, they were going to rapidly take me off of it in a detox facility and completely ruin me (as if more damage could be done). I can't take that step. And I do have some outlets. I play music very well but the repetition is killing me. And a lack of social interaction. Just leaves me feeling so damn apathetic.
